subject: Grace-window compensation proposal for Lighthouse incident
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@lighthouse.ai>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@lighthouse.ai
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Service gap on 11/26 — request for relief

Hi Tessa / Marissa,

Thanks again for the post-incident write-up you shared earlier. Lighthouse logged a visible downturn in request success and higher tail latency between 11/26 02:40–03:10 UTC that impacted our checkout flows. Our engineering and procurement teams have reviewed the timeline and would like to request a commercial remediation (credits or billing relief) for the affected window.

Can you propose a short-term remedy (billing credit structure or free capacity for one month) that we can present to our CFO next week? We want something simple to close this out quickly — a single-line proposal with numbers and the acceptance path (DocuSign or email OK).

Attaching the Lighthouse incident extract and a short spike chart (uptime-window-analysis.csv).

Appreciate a quick reply.

—Alex
Alex Rivera
Head of Platform Engineering, Lighthouse AI
alex.rivera@lighthouse.ai
From: tessa.morgan@redwood.com <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@lighthouse.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Service gap on 11/26 — request for relief

Alex — thanks for the details and the chart. We reviewed the incident trace and our internal postmortem. Short summary: there was a transient autoscaler misconfiguration combined with a routing table sync that increased tail latency for 30m and caused elevated error rates for certain batch patterns.

Proposed quick remedy for Lighthouse (initial offer for CFO review):
- One month of service credit equivalent to 20% of November invoice, applied as a billing credit on next invoice; OR
- If you prefer capacity instead of a dollar credit: 2 reserved instances (equivalent to your current burst profile) free for one month plus a 10% credit on overage tokens.

We will also offer a technical package (no additional charge) to prevent recurrence: a dedicated sync window with our SRE team, plus a config guard for your production autoscaling rules.

Attachments: proposed-compensation-summary.pdf (summary & math).

This package is within my commercial authority up to $45k equivalent. If Lighthouse prefers the 20% invoice credit and the remediation exceeds that, I need exec signoff. Can you confirm which option your CFO would prefer? If you want the credit path, I will pull Marissa and Jonas in for final approval and route a DocuSign acceptance link.

Next steps I suggest: you tell us preferred option by EOD tomorrow, we draft a one-page amendment, and send it for signature.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Lead — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Service gap on 11/26 — request for relief

Tessa / Jonas — looping you both for exec clearance.

Tessa has a good first-pass offer (20% invoice credit OR 2 reserved instances + 10% overage credit). Per policy, anything above $45k needs VP signoff; the 20% credit on Lighthouse's November invoice calculates to ~$62k based on their run-rate, so we need one-off approval or an adjusted structure (split across two invoices or temper credit to 15%).

My recommendation to keep the renewal healthy and move fast: offer a blended concession — 15% invoice credit + the technical prevention package + a one-month free reserved instance (instead of two). That brings the commercial cost down to ~40k and gives Lighthouse visible operational remediation.

If Jonas can greenlight up to $50k, we can accept the blended package. Otherwise, if Jonas prefers to stay under $45k, we offer the reduced terms (12% credit + one reserved instance).

Please advise — Lighthouse needs a single-line proposal for their CFO. I'll prep the DocuSign template once we have approval.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success & Renewals
Redwood Inference
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@lighthouse.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 15:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Service gap on 11/26 — request for relief

All — I reviewed the numbers and Marissa's blended approach looks reasonable. Executive approval: greenlight up to $50,000 equivalent concession for Lighthouse AI as follows:

1) 15% credit on the November invoice (applied as a one-line billing credit on your next invoice).
2) One month of one reserved instance (matching Lighthouse's burst profile) at no charge.
3) Complimentary SRE remediation session (two 90-minute windows) to lock down autoscaler rules.

Tessa — proceed to draft the one-page amendment and send the DocuSign packet to Alex (procurement@lighthouse.ai). Include an acceptance cut-off of 2026-12-08 to keep timelines tight.

Alex — happy to close this quickly; accept by email or sign the DocuSign link Marissa will send.

Jonas Weber
VP, Sales Operations & Commercials
Redwood Inference
